issue.title: Treat pomodoro_start_timing like pomodoro_start_task in Mac closePendingTrim
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Bob Mac Capture should treat the new pomodoro_start_timing need like pomodoro_start_task in CapturePanelModel.closePendingTrim, so a dangling =#bugs@ previews calmly instead of flashing Bob's execution error for one keystroke. New need value is additive ([String]-decoded needs); no bob-mac-capture change was made in this tale per the plan non-goals.

Why out of scope: the trailing-@ tale explicitly excludes bob-mac-capture code changes; this is the deferred Mac-side handling of the additive JSON contract.
